context: Docs batch for field #3/#4 written and review-fixed: Doc 4 response, UPGRADE-v2 multi-host + merging sections, README paragraph, FOUNDATION-PLAN D2/D5 annotations, Doc 2 errata; 3-lens read-only review applied
rationale: EXECUTED: --show-toplevel returns the WORKTREE root from a linked worktree, so a drain run there would commit the worktree's tracked copy and never the freshly exported records (which land in the main checkout); in a worktree `.git` is a file so the file test is vacuous. The common-dir form resolved to the main checkout from both the main checkout and a linked worktree; the rev-parse probe exits 1 when no merge is in progress. Optional files (config.yml, .gitignore) are added through an `if [ -f ]` loop because `git add` of an absent pathspec is fatal (exit 128, nothing staged).
summary: Drain recipe resolves ROOT via `cd "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/.."` and probes MERGE_HEAD with `git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD`, not `--show-toplevel` / `test -f .git/MERGE_HEAD`
